title: Accepted LMTR v1 local shapes — not standalone conformance
description: Accepted R1b review-2 local shapes. Normative prose supplies lexical/cross-field/binary/resource/ordering rules. No network resolution.

I.description: Local numeric shape only; prose additionally requires a nonnegative integer lexical token (also rejecting -0), not exponent/fraction/boolean. Schema libraries alone cannot enforce that lexical distinction.

Parent.description: One actual frozen source file only; not a directory/dataset/member inventory. Historical dataset conversion needs a future required feature; optional unknown fields cannot redefine these semantics.
